text: 1、烈士纪念日向人民英雄敬献花篮仪式在京隆重举行； 2、庆祝中华人民共和国成立77周年招待会在京举行 习近平发表重要讲话； 3、人民日报社论：在新的伟大征程上接续奋斗再创辉煌——热烈庆祝中华人民共和国成立七十七周年； 4、习近平同文莱苏丹就中文建交35周年互致贺电； 5、【“十五五”开好局起好步】我国加快建设现代化水网； 6、9月制造业采购经理指数回升 重回扩张区间； 7、喜迎国庆 各地节日氛围浓厚； 8、254项国家标准10月1日起实施； 9、中欧联合研制“微笑”卫星首批观测图像发布； 10、经港珠澳大桥供港鲜活食品明天起将全天通关； 11、我驻国际组
text_en: 1. The flower basket presentation ceremony to people's heroes on Martyrs' Day was grandly held in Beijing; 2. The reception celebrating the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China was held in Beijing, and Xi Jinping delivered an important speech; 3. People's Daily editorial: Continue striving and create new glory on the new great journey - warmly celebrating the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China; 4. Xi Jinping and the Sultan of Brunei exchanged congratulatory messages on the 35th anniversary of the establishment of China-Brunei diplomatic relations; 5. [Getting off to a good start and making good progress in the 15th Five-Year Plan] China is accelerating the construction of a modern water network; 6. The September manufacturing purchasing managers' index rebounded and returned to the expansion range; 7. Welcoming National Day, festive atmosphere is strong across the country; 8. 254 national standards will take effect from October 1; 9. The first batch of observation images from the 'Smile' satellite jointly developed by China and Europe was released; 10.
